subject: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep

Team — attaching the first pass of the May leadership dashboard and the QBR prep checklist. I want us to run a short "metrics clearance" before the exec readout next Wednesday so nothing surprises the board. High-level asks: 

- Confirm latency and 95th/99th percentiles for hosted API (call out long tails).
- Verify the customer-level usage spikes in the ACME account between May 3–9 and whether caching changes explain it.
- Approve the cost adjustments in the attached sheet (see tab "Cost-ops-suggest").
- Validate uptime windows for the same period — we had three infra rollbacks that may have impacted metrics.

I attached: May-dashboard-v1.pdf, okrs-tracker-may.csv, qbr-prep-sprint-checklist.docx. Please review and post any corrections inline by EOD Tuesday. If any numbers need a runbook or incident postmortem, flag them and assign an owner.

I'll coordinate a 30-minute pre-brief Tuesday 10:00–10:30 PT if that works; can we lock that?

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com, ellie.singh@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep

On Sun, May 17, 2026 at 3:12 PM laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the first pass of the May leadership dashboard and the QBR prep checklist. 

Thanks Laura — reviewed the PDF and the tracker quickly. A few notes:

- Latency: The 99th reported in the PDF is pulled from the regional aggregate; per-service 99th for the inference runtime is ~18% higher in us-west2 for long-tail requests. I'll attach a short delta table into the Drive link.
- Usage spike (May 3–9): Ellie from ACME confirms they had a heavy eval job; that explains ~62% of the burst. However, our cache hit-rate fell by 12% the same window (see JIRA INF-9247). I suspect a config slip on the caching tier.
- Cost adjustments: the proposed amortization for burst GPUs in tab "Cost-ops-suggest" looks right but we need signoff from Markus for the accounting treatment.
- Uptime: There were two rollbacks (05/04 and 05/07) caused by a model rollout. Ops has a short notes file.

I pushed an updated spreadsheet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cDq_dashboard_may (sheet name: "May-deltas"). Please pull numbers from that when we finalize. I'll be on the Tuesday pre-brief.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep

Thanks — adding a concise action list from Product side: 

1) Confirmed: I'll own validating the per-service 99th calculation and will reconcile the dashboard with Irene's "May-deltas" sheet (owner: marissa_cole, due: Tue 5/19 5pm PT).
2) ACME usage: I'll ask Ellie for their scheduled eval window details and get the exact job IDs to correlate with our logs (owner: marissa_cole, due: Tue 5/19 noon PT).
3) Cost amortization: Markus, can you confirm whether we treat burst GPUs as OPEX or CAPEX for this projection? If you approve, I'll update the forecast tab.
4) Pre-brief: Tuesday 10:00–10:30 PT works for me; please add a calendar invite.

Attachment: qbr-prep-sprint-checklist.docx (minor edits).

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: ellie.singh@acme.com <ellie.singh@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep

Hi all — quick clarification from ACME side: 

- The eval jobs were scheduled between May 3 02:00 UTC and May 7 05:00 UTC. Two of them were reruns of a large batch and did cause a sustained token-generation load. I can share job IDs in the pre-brief.
- We saw a small increase in repeated full-context calls which likely reduced effective cache hits (we changed our client-side caching TTL during the test). We'll share the TTL values.

No objections to the numbers Irene surfaced; happy to join the pre-brief.

—Ellie Singh
Senior Product Manager, ACME Cloud

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: ellie.singh@acme.com, ops@acme.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 18:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership metrics clearance — May dashboard and QBR prep

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Final checklist before pre-brief (Tuesday 10:00 PT):

- Marissa: reconcile 99th percentiles with Irene's sheet and post the reconciled table to Drive (due Tue 5/19 17:00 PT).
- Irene: confirm whether cache config rollback is documented in INF-9247 and paste the short notes in the Drive sheet (due Tue 5/19 12:00 PT).
- Markus: please confirm cost treatment by Tue 5/19 17:00 PT so we can lock numbers for the exec deck.
- Ellie/ACME: please bring job IDs and TTL values to the pre-brief.

I'll send the calendar invite for Tue 10:00–10:30 PT and attach the reconciled dashboard to the pre-brief invite when available. If anything blocks these asks, escalate to me directly.

Laura
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
